ai-denoise.description: FDnCNN AI denoise (NCNN/Vulkan) for watermark residual cleanup. Adds volk for the Vulkan loader; requires the NCNN submodule.

regen.description: SynthID diffusion-regeneration (SDXL img2img via leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp). Adds curl (the SHA256-pinned model downloader) and openssl (the integrity gate). Requires the stable-diffusion.cpp submodule.
